title: Spiral staircase
summary: helix sweep, screw pattern, stair rule
description: A steel spiral staircase with oak treads, Ø 1600 mm and 2800 mm floor to floor, on a Ø 114.3 mm column, with a helical handrail and a landing, checked against DIN 18065.
process: Steel fabrication (cut, bore, laser cut, weld, bend the handrail, powder coat), CNC-routed oak treads, assembly on site

difficulty.rationale: One helical sweep with tangent datum planes and four screw patterns on top of 74 coupled formulas that derive the stair from DIN 18065 and the 100 mm sphere rule; headroom proven across bodies with gauge solids; five kernel limits worked around.

materials: Steel S235, powder coated anthracite grey (RAL 7016)

prompt_test.model: Claude Sonnet 5.5, medium effort, through craft3d-cli
prompt_test.result: Passed: 15 risers of 186.667 mm, 14 treads at 30°, 60° landing, walking line 487.5 mm, going 255.24 mm, step measure 628.58 mm, usable width 653.3 mm, 4 balusters per tread 84.72 mm apart, column 10.88 kg/m, carriers 128.5 kg, all as this example's; checks pass at five range points, no interference; two edge-of-tolerance refusals worked round (rail plug union; landing round-over at exactly 180°, F-113); about 311 steps.
